turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². Return the area (km², 1 dp) of the Voronoi cell belonging to the Sha Tin station (station_id 11).
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT id, (coordinate::geometry) AS geom
  FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
  SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry) AS geom
  FROM pts
),
voro AS (
  SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(p.geom), 0.0, b.geom))).geom AS geom
  FROM pts p CROSS JOIN bbox b
),
cells AS (
  SELECT p.id AS station_id, ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.geom) AS geom
  FROM voro v
  CROSS JOIN bbox b
  JOIN pts p ON ST_Intersects(v.geom, p.geom)
),
areas AS (
  SELECT station_id, ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
  FROM cells
  WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS cell_count,
  ROUND(SUM(area_km2)::numeric, 6) AS total_area_km2,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN station_id = 11 THEN area_km2 END)::numeric, 1) AS shatin_area_km2
FROM areas;
""")

res = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
shatin_cell_km2 = float(res.loc[0, "shatin_area_km2"])
print({
    "cell_count": int(res.loc[0, "cell_count"]),
    "total_area_km2": float(res.loc[0, "total_area_km2"]),
    "shatin_cell_km2": shatin_cell_km2
})

from sqlalchemy import text

  SELECT id, coordinate::geometry AS geom
  FROM air_quality_station
),
agg AS (
  SELECT ST_Collect(geom) AS pts_geom, ST_Envelope(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry) AS bbox_geom

),

  SELECT p.id AS station_id, ST_Intersection(v.geom, a.bbox_geom) AS geom
  FROM voro v
  CROSS JOIN agg a
  JOIN pts p ON ST_Intersects(v.geom, p.geom)
),
areas AS (
  SELECT station_id, ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2

  WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT id, ST_SetSRID(coordinate::geometry, 4326) AS geom
  FROM air_quality_station
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ST_SetSRID(ST_Collect(geom), 4326) AS pts_geom,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_Envelope(ST_Extent(geom)::geometry), 4326) AS bbox_geom
  FROM pts
),
voro AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID((ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(pts_geom, 0.0, bbox_geom))).geom, 4326) AS geom
  FROM agg
),
cells AS (
  SELECT p.id AS station_id, ST_Intersection(v.geom, a.bbox_geom) AS geom
  FROM voro v
  CROSS JOIN agg a
  JOIN pts p ON ST_Covers(v.geom, p.geom)
),
areas AS (
  SELECT station_id, ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1000000.0 AS area_km2
  FROM cells
  WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS cell_count,
  ROUND(SUM(area_km2)::numeric, 6) AS total_area_km2,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN station_id = 11 THEN area_km2 END)::numeric, 1) AS shatin_area_km2
FROM areas;
""")

res = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
shatin_cell_km2 = float(res.loc[0, "shatin_area_km2"])
print({
    "cell_count": int(res.loc[0, "cell_count"]),
    "total_area_km2": float(res.loc[0, "total_area_km2"]),
    "shatin_cell_km2": shatin_cell_km2
})
